indicators.flag: A customer makes multiple cash deposits just below the currency transaction reporting threshold within a short period, in a pattern consistent with structuring to avoid the filing requirement.
indicators.red_flag: Structuring — repeated sub-threshold cash deposits to evade CTR filing
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).

indicators.flag: Funds are deposited and then promptly withdrawn or transferred out within one to two business days, leaving a minimal balance and showing no apparent business or personal purpose for the pass-through activity.
indicators.red_flag: Rapid in-and-out movement with no economic purpose (pass-through account)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C2 (Rapid pass-through / flow-through (receive-and-forward) detection).

indicators.flag: A long-dormant account suddenly resumes activity with high-value incoming wires followed by rapid disbursement, inconsistent with the account's historical profile.
indicators.red_flag: Dormant account suddenly reactivated with high-value flow-through
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.flag: A customer sends or receives international wire transfers involving high-risk jurisdictions with no documented economic purpose or relationship to the destination country.
indicators.red_flag: Unexplained wires to/from high-risk jurisdictions with no customer nexus
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.flag: An account shows repeated transfers of identical round-dollar amounts to a single beneficiary, a pattern inconsistent with commercial invoicing or payroll behaviour.
indicators.red_flag: Repeated identical round-amount transfers to one beneficiary
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C1 (Customer-profile / out-of-pattern transaction monitoring); data D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)).

indicators.flag: A business customer's cash deposit volume substantially and persistently exceeds the expected activity stated in its onboarding profile, without a corresponding change in the declared nature of the business.
indicators.red_flag: Cash deposits far exceeding the declared business cash profile
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C5 (Cash-intensity / cash-placement anomaly detection); data D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data).

indicators.flag: Multiple apparently unrelated third parties deposit funds into one personal account, which is then drawn down by the account holder, suggesting use of the account to pool or relay funds on behalf of others.
indicators.red_flag: Multiple unrelated third parties funding one personal account (pooling/relay)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: An account exhibits a sudden spike in transaction frequency relative to its own historical baseline that is not explained by seasonality or a documented life event.
indicators.red_flag: Sudden transaction-velocity spike vs the account's own baseline
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C6 (Transaction-velocity & dormancy / baseline-deviation monitoring).

indicators.flag: An account receives cash deposits in multiple geographically dispersed locations followed by prompt consolidated withdrawal or onward transfer elsewhere, consistent with funnel account activity used to move illicit proceeds across regions.
indicators.red_flag: Funnel account — dispersed multi-city cash-in, consolidated withdrawal elsewhere
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C3 (Multi-originator funnel-in / fan-out network detection).

indicators.flag: Incoming wire transfers repeatedly arrive with missing or incomplete originator information, suggesting deliberate stripping of payment details to obscure the source of funds.
indicators.red_flag: Incoming wires with stripped or incomplete originator information
indicators.rationale: Gap; buildable now with C10 (Transaction-narrative / memo-line keyword screening) on D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)).

build_logic.logic: Flag a payment whose memo, reference, or narrative field matches high-risk keyword or coded-language patterns, escalating when flagged terms recur across a customer's payments or conflict with the stated counterparty relationship.
build_logic.source: wire/EMT/payment message free-text fields + curated keyword taxonomy
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.flag: A customer who is the subject of credible adverse media regarding financial crime begins using new product lines or channels that materially increase the complexity or opacity of their activity.
indicators.red_flag: Adverse-media subject expanding into opaque or higher-risk products
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence intelligence).

indicators.flag: A customer splits international remittances into multiple below-threshold transactions routed through different money services businesses to the same destination, consistent with deliberate fragmentation to avoid scrutiny.
indicators.red_flag: Remittances fragmented across MSBs below thresholds to one destination
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C4 (Structuring / sub-threshold & reporting-trigger evasion).
